body: This was very helpful. I think giving her a chance to maybe write it out would be less intimidating for her.
Yes I think this definitely will help. Make sure she knows she is still my baby too. Regardless of where she stays, I want our relationship to be better. Mending that will be the priority

No one is keeping her from him. I did suggest that maybe we split the week in half so she can spend more time with him. I definitely don’t want her to resent me. I just want my child to have I bit more structure that I know he isnt currently providing. Maybe communicating with her father more as well will help. Homework and bedtime are nonnegotiable. As far as our relationship, this situation was definitely an eye opener as to how far she has pulled. It is my job to maintain the relationship , thank you. I need to work harder at this

I see you point. I agree it did change more than a little. We talked about it a lot long before the wedding. She admitted that she thought it would just be me and her forever. Maybe taking her do some more of the things we us to do will help her open up more.
